summary: Iteration-5 frontend-only test of the fixed /bible idle slide (IdleWelcome). All 5 required scenarios pass: (1) Idle with church_name='Providence Baptist Church' at 1920x1080 and 1080x1920 renders accent bar, 'Welcome to' [bible-idle-title], uppercase church name [bible-idle-church-name], and today's date 'Friday, October 9, 2026' [bible-idle-date] in a single centered column with no overlap and no church-name-top/bottom row (both absent) and no bible-idle-logo (no logo). Rect verification: title.bottom=450 < name.top=466 < date.top=719 — vertically stacked, no overlap. (2) Idle with empty church_name OR church_name_show=false both correctly collapse to a single big 'Welcome' + date (church-name element absent). (3) After uploading a 1x1 PNG logo and reloading /bible, bible-idle-logo renders ABOVE the accent bar (logo.y=216, title.y=458). (4) /settings-admin preview iframe with Sample content toggled OFF renders the same IdleWelcome layout and live-updates when the name is edited: typing 'LIVE TEST NAME' + Save shows new name in the iframe AND in a separately-opened /bible tab (WebSocket live push works). (5) Regression: /bible passage slide (sent via POST /api/bible/publish) still renders church-name-top with logo, bible-verse-text, bible-reference — unchanged behavior, no bible-idle-* elements. /register unaffected (uses its own layout, never consumed IdleWelcome).
critical_code_review_comments: IdleWelcome.jsx — clean: `showName = a?.church_name_show !== false && churchName?.trim()` correctly treats missing appearance as show, empty name as hide, and `church_name_show=false` as hide. Logo guard reuses church_name_show so toggling it off also hides the logo on the idle slide (acceptable, matches request's 'show just Welcome + date' expectation).
Date is computed with `toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday, month, day, year })` and refreshed every 60s via `useToday` — will cross midnight correctly on a 24/7 display.

Font-size switch at churchName.length>28 (7.5vmin vs 9.5vmin) keeps 'PROVIDENCE BAPTIST CHURCH' (24 chars) at the larger size on both landscape and portrait; still fits (name.width ~1690/1920 landscape, ~950/1080 portrait).
BibleDisplay.jsx continues to render ChurchName top/bottom only in passage mode, so the regression requirement is enforced by code path separation (not by prop); clear and correct.
accent bar is a plain div using var(--ss-accent, #f59e0b) — if admin sets accent_color this will update live via appearanceVars; good.

Minor nit (not a bug): on very narrow portrait viewports the 9.5vmin name can wrap to 2 lines (observed at 1080x1920 — 'PROVIDENCE' / 'BAPTIST CHURCH'); textWrap:'balance' is applied so wrapping is balanced. No overlap with accent bar or date.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 scenarios: 1920 idle, 1080 idle, empty name, name_show=false, logo-above-bar, settings live update, passage regression)

seed_data_creation: Uploaded a transient 1x1 PNG logo (DELETE /api/appearance/logo at teardown). Briefly set church_name='' and church_name_show=false then restored. Published a John 3:16 passage then POST /api/bible/display/clear. Final state restored exactly: church_name='Providence Baptist Church', church_logo_url=null, bible.image_url=/api/appearance/image/6ac909c3e7451556ccf1dd8a (user's background preserved), panel_opacity=0, image_blur=25, image_dim=80, church_name_show=true, church_logo_show=true, register appearance at prior defaults, bible mode=idle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Idle slide implementation now lives in /app/frontend/src/components/live/IdleWelcome.jsx and is rendered only from IdleSlide in BibleDisplay.jsx (when no idle.image_url). Test IDs: bible-idle-logo (above accent bar), bible-idle-title ('Welcome to' when name present, else 'Welcome'), bible-idle-church-name, bible-idle-date, bible-idle-subtitle. On passage mode the top/bottom testids are church-name-top|bottom and church-logo-top|bottom (ChurchName component in DisplayBackground.jsx) — unchanged. PUT /api/appearance/church-name body is {church_name:string} (NOT {name}) — easy mistake. Settings-admin preview iframe exposes 'Sample content' switch; toggling off is required to see the idle layout in the embedded preview.
rca of the issue: Original bug (church name overlapping the gold accent bar) was caused by rendering ChurchName at place='top' AND a large 'Welcome' h1 in the same idle layout, both anchored near the top of the screen. Fix (now verified): the idle slide now uses a dedicated IdleWelcome component that stacks logo → accent bar → 'Welcome to' → church name → date → subtitle in a single centered flex column, and BibleDisplay no longer renders the generic ChurchName row on the idle slide. Overlap eliminated; new date line added as requested.
